title: Abraham's Example of Tithing and the High Priest Jesus
description: In this powerful message, Pastor Chris Zehner dives into the story of Abraham and his tithe, revealing a timeless truth about God's expectation for our giving. You'll discover why giving 10% of your income to God is more than just a biblical command - it's a privilege that unleashes His presence and provision in your life. Join Pastor Chris as he unlocks the secrets of biblical stewardship and equips you to live a life of generosity and faith.
